name: staleProtectionJobsCount
definition: The number of devices whose backup job is stale: backup_status is Failed, Offline, Blocked, Cancelled or Suspended, next_backup is in the past, or no backup timestamp is recorded. An error, refusal, empty device list, or any device with no backup_status, last_backup or next_backup is Not evaluated, never 0.
population: the devices the credential's company returns from the device summary; numerator = devices judged stale
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A read of the device summary in which every device carries a backup_status, last_backup or next_backup; 0 only when none of them is stale. An error, refusal, empty or partial read is Not evaluated.

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real IDrive body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: A device record with none of backup_status, last_backup and next_backup is unreadable, not healthy; one such record makes the whole count null with a dataCollection error. An unparseable next_backup is not read as overdue.
